title: Membership in the corresponding block
statement: For natural numbers $w,s$ and an index $i$ among the $sw$ coordinates, let $(a,b)$ be the pair of block and within-block indices corresponding to $i$ under the standard identification of $	ext{Fin}(sw)$ with $	ext{Fin}(s)\times\text{Fin}(w)$. Then $i$ belongs to the set of coordinates in block $a$.
